scoring_justification: Full recompute of efficiency from device equations is infeasible in checker sandbox; result-level comparison against paper-reported grid with tolerance and structural checks provides the strongest feasible verification.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference efficiency grid (T_ph, kappa_sigma, eta_max) from paper Fig.6(b) and reported analytic bound.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig.6(b) (efficiency curves) and derived bound in main text. Values match the reference solve.sh.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from published efficiency data at the specified parameter points. The analytic bound is computed from the formula with optimal barrier height 0.55 eV.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual paper-reported results that define the reproduction target; they are not fabricated.
